observations: Target passes 0xdeca (0xdec7 + 3) to a DOS interrupt using an indirect AX function value, then writes drive letter, colon and backslash at 0xdec7.
When byte 0xdfcf is nonzero, it invokes INT 21h with AX=7160h, CX=8002h and SI=DI=0xdec7.
An alternate branch derives the directory prefix at 0xdec7 from a pathname at 0xe0d7.

The directory display routine selects the 0xdec7 control when byte 0xe599 is zero. The flag is set during a branch associated with the same option bit used for subdirectory handling; its exact semantic scope requires further tracing.
baseline_correspondence: cmd/command/tcmd2a.asm build_dir_string prepares drive colon backslash and obtains current directory into BWDBUF+3; cmd/command/dir.asm DisplayHeader then prints DirHead_Ptr.
limitations: The routine uses an indirect DOS function number; it is not assumed to always be a particular function.
